quarterly_data.quarter: Organo results briefing Q&A: FY Ended March 31, 2026 Results Presentation (05-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A) on margins: the recent earnings improvement came from better margins on large-scale plant projects - favorable demand, contracts reflecting raw material price increases and effective cost management. The company considers the profitability improvement of overseas plant projects in the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 to be temporary: it assumes stable margins in Taiwan, while in the United States it plans to receive multiple large-scale orders and margins may fluctuate (further improvement may be difficult) if construction work is included in the contract scope; it will work to maintain the current profit level.

quarterly_data.quarter: Organo results briefing Q&A: FY Ended March 31, 2026 Results Presentation (05-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A): with investment in cutting-edge semiconductors currently very active, the company is focusing for the time being on expanding engineering capacity to support sales growth, strengthening delivery capacity for large-scale plant projects. The Organo Group increased headcount by a total of 100 people in the previous fiscal year and plans to add approximately 200 people in the current fiscal year (also using AI to improve engineering efficiency); the significant SG&A increase in the FY ending 03/2027 plan reflects personnel expenses (new-graduate and experienced hiring, wage increases) plus investment in IT infrastructure and R&D.
quarterly_data.figure: Headcount +100 in the previous fiscal year; approximately 200 more planned in the current fiscal year

quarterly_data.quarter: Organo results briefing Q&A: FY Ended March 31, 2026 Results Presentation (05-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A): net sales of facility-owned services are assumed to grow to approximately JPY 25.0 billion in the fiscal year ending March 31, 2028. The operating margin assumption for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2031 in ORGANO 2030 was raised because investment in cutting-edge semiconductors in the United States and Taiwan has become more active than a year earlier, with some investments being brought forward, although geopolitical risks including the Middle East make the environment difficult to predict. Projects that had been scheduled to be received in the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 shifted to the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 because of adjustments in the customer's investment schedule (management believes this is unrelated to the Middle East situation) and are factored into the FY ending March 2027 order intake plan.
quarterly_data.figure: Facility-owned services net sales approximately JPY 25.0 billion in the fiscal year ending March 31, 2028

quarterly_data.quarter: Organo results briefing Q&A: FY Ended March 31, 2026 Results Presentation (05-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A) on new demand areas: large-scale data centers such as those for AI servers use significant volumes of water but do not require high-purity water, so they are not a major business opportunity for Organo; it does expect increased demand for water treatment chemicals used in cooling water and is actively pursuing sales there. Maintenance demand (replacement of expendable items) is expanding with the restart of nuclear power plants, but the impact on consolidated results is minimal because the scale of sales remains limited.

quarterly_data.quarter: Organo results briefing Q&A: FY Ended March 31, 2026 Results Presentation (05-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A) on regions and risks: the United States is the company's highest-priority market, though its current top priority there is responding to existing customers (later a multifaceted approach including functional materials and new sewerage-related technologies). In China, localization driven by U.S. export regulations is advancing and competition with local companies is expected to intensify, and Chinese water treatment companies are expanding into Southeast Asia, so Organo is reconsidering its China and Southeast Asia strategy; in India it established a subsidiary in February 2026, expects medium- to long-term market growth and will consider M&A as one potential approach. At present no major raw material procurement difficulties have occurred, though delivery schedules with customers may need adjusting; foreign exchange sensitivity is low because overseas business is centered on local procurement.
